legislation.via: Gaceta Oficial de la República de Cuba (gacetaoficial.gob.cu)
legislation.note: Gazette norm database (~103 Leyes, search by type/number/year/summary) + issue PDFs; Ley 59/1987 Código Civil not indexed, served from the site's 2022 updated edition; missing: Leyes not indexed (checked 2026-11-10: Ley 41/1983 and Ley 51/1985 absent; Leyes 65, 75, 76, 85, 113 present; the site's issue archive starts in 1990, so pre-1990 acts never republished are not online at all); completeness of the Gazette norm database for pre-2019 in-force acts is unverified (older acts mostly indexed only as later republications); texts as published, amendments not applied; norms without a code open as their whole issue
